snippet.title: Sam, we talked about this! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Every sentence, image and video on the internet will feed Sam's bottomless hunger! Train your models, grow your subscribers, buy new hardware and scrape even more data, all to build a super-duper artificial intelligence and leave every rival behind.

Free demo out now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145340/?utm_source=youTube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=trailer
